# `select.grow`: Grow group

Adds the neighbouring rings of elements to a group (faces across edges, edges and vertices through vertices).

- Category: select
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(n + H) for any step count
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups
- Also known as: select more, grow selection, ctrl plus

Grows a group by `steps` rings. Use `save_as` to keep the original group.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | `string` | required | Group to grow or shrink. |
| `save_as` | `string \| null` | `null` | Store the result under this name instead of changing the group. |
| `steps` | `number` | `1` | Rings of neighbours to add or remove. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"group":"top","save_as":"top_ring","target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): grew group top_ring (5 faces)`
